title: Roasted Mediterranean Tomato Soup
description: A flavorful and comforting soup made with roasted tomatoes and a hint of Mediterranean spices.
instructions: Toss tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast tomatoes in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
In a large pot, sauté garlic in a bit of olive oil until fragrant.
Add vegetable broth, Mediterranean soup mix, and roasted tomatoes to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Blend the soup using an immersion blender or a regular blender.
Stir in chopped peppery olives and adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional olives and a sprinkle of feta cheese if desired.
